7	import React from 'react'
8	import PropTypes from 'prop-types'
9	import {FormattedMessage, FormattedNumber} from 'react-intl'
10	import {
11	    Stack,
12	    Text,
13	    useBreakpointValue
14	} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'
15	import {useItemVariant} from '.'
16	import {getPriceData} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/product-utils'
17	import DisplayPrice from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/display-price'
18	
19	const PricePerItem = ({currency, basePrice}) => {
20	    return (
21	        <Text fontSize={{base: '12px', lg: '14px'}}>
22	            <FormattedNumber style="currency" currency={currency} value={basePrice} />
23	            <FormattedMessage
24	                defaultMessage="ea"
25	                id="price_per_item.label.each"
26	                description="Abbreviated 'each', follows price per item, like $10/ea"
27	            />
28	        </Text>
29	    )
30	}
31	
32	PricePerItem.propTypes = {
33	    currency: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
34	    basePrice: PropTypes.number
35	}
36	
37	/**
38	 * In the context of a cart product item variant, this component renders the item's
39	 * pricing, taking into account applied discounts as well as base item prices.
40	 */
41	const ItemPrice = ({currency, align = 'right', baseDirection = 'column', ...props}) => {
42	    const variant = useItemVariant()
43	    const {price, priceAfterItemDiscount} = variant
44	    const isASet = variant?.type?.set
45	    const isMaster = variant?.type?.master
46	    let priceData
47	    // When variant has basket pricing, we should prioritize these prices for displaying
48	    // since they may have take promotion/discount into account
49	    // NOTE: try NOT to re-calculate these values since basket-level discount is complicated
50	    if (variant?.itemId) {
51	        priceData = {
52	            currentPrice: priceAfterItemDiscount,
53	            // we don't want to show strikethrough price for cart since listPrice is not available via basket pricing
54	            listPrice: null,
55	            pricePerUnit: variant?.pricePerUnit,
56	            isASet,
57	            isMaster,
58	            isRange: isASet || isMaster || false,
59	            isOnSale: price > priceAfterItemDiscount
60	        }
61	    } else {
62	        // for wishlist page we extract price info from variant/product obj
63	        priceData = getPriceData(variant)
64	    }
65	    const isDesktop = useBreakpointValue({base: false, lg: true})
66	
67	    return (
68	        <Stack
69	            textAlign={align}
70	            direction={baseDirection}
71	            justifyContent={align === 'left' ? 'flex-start' : 'flex-end'}
72	            alignItems="baseline"
73	            spacing={priceData?.isOnSale ? 0 : 1}
74	            wrap="nowrap"
75	            {...props}
76	        >
77	            {!isDesktop && variant?.quantity > 1 && !isASet && priceData?.pricePerUnit && (
78	                <PricePerItem currency={currency} basePrice={priceData.pricePerUnit} />
79	            )}
80	
81	            {variant?.itemId ? (
82	                <DisplayPrice
83	                    labelForA11y={variant?.name}
84	                    currency={currency}
85	                    priceData={priceData}
86	                    listPriceProps={{fontSize: 'sm'}}
87	                />
88	            ) : (
89	                <DisplayPrice
90	                    labelForA11y={variant?.name}
91	                    currency={currency}
92	                    priceData={priceData}
93	                    quantity={variant?.quantity}
94	                    listPriceProps={{fontSize: 'sm'}}
95	                />
96	            )}
97	
98	            {isDesktop && variant?.quantity > 1 && !isASet && priceData?.pricePerUnit && (
99	                <PricePerItem currency={currency} basePrice={priceData.pricePerUnit} />
100	            )}
101	        </Stack>
102	    )
103	}
104	
105	ItemPrice.propTypes = {
106	    currency: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
107	    align: PropTypes.string,
108	    baseDirection: PropTypes.string
109	}
110	
111	export default ItemPrice

 * own `{...props}` placement (spread last) — so a caller-supplied `color` or `to` is silently
 * overridden here instead of taking precedence, unlike those three siblings. This is a verbatim,
 * byte-for-byte port of the base file per SFCC-270's zero-functional-diff scope (plan step 2.1);

import React from 'react'
import {useItemVariant} from '.'
import Link from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/link'
import {Heading} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'

/**
 * In the context of a cart product item variant, this components simply renders
 * the item's name using the cart item field `productName`. We use this field
 * rather than variant `name` field as the variant detail may not yet be
 * available upon rendering.
 */
const ItemName = (props: Record<string, any>) => {
    console.log('[overrides] item-name.tsx')
    const variant = useItemVariant()
    const productId = variant?.master?.masterId || variant.id

    return (
        <Heading as="h2" fontSize="md">
            <Link {...props} color="black.600" to={`/product/${productId}`}>
                {variant.productName || variant.name}
            </Link>
        </Heading>
    )
}

export default ItemName

/*

/*
 * Copy-first port of node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-item/index.jsx
 * (retail-react-app 10.0.0), converted to TypeScript per AGENTS.md's copy-first rule (SFCC-270,
 * plan step 2.1). Zero functional diff at this step — TypeScript annotations, the import path
 * rewrites documented below, and the temporary `[overrides]` console.log marker are the only
 * changes; styling/behaviour changes are a later commit (2.2), not this one.
 *
 * Import path rewrites, per .claude/rules/overrideStyling.md's "Importing an already-overridden
 * component from a new component":
 * - `item-variant` / `item-variant/item-image` / `item-variant/item-name` /
 *   `item-variant/item-attributes` / `item-variant/item-price`: this repo overrides all five
 *   (SFCC-270, this same commit), so these are relative imports rather than the base
 *   `@salesforce/retail-react-app/...` path — a base-path import here would silently exercise the
 *   unstyled base components in Storybook/Vitest instead of these overrides.
 * - `./bonus-product-quantity` / `./product-quantity-picker`: same reasoning, both overridden in
 *   this same commit, in this same folder.
 * - `responsive` (`HideOnDesktop`/`HideOnMobile`): also already overridden in this repo
 *   (overrides/app/components/responsive/index.tsx) — and not just a styling port, a genuine
 *   behavioural difference (it moves the mobile/desktop split to Chakra's `md` breakpoint instead
 *   of the base's `lg`) — so this is rewritten to a relative import too, for the same reason.
 * - `shared/ui`, `loading-spinner`, `utils/utils`, and the `app/hooks` barrel (`useCurrency`/
 *   `useDerivedProduct`) are NOT overridden anywhere in this repo (verified by directory listing
 *   at time of writing) — these stay on the base `@salesforce/retail-react-app/...` path, since
 *   there is no local override to redirect to.
 *
 * `SfccProduct` is kept as `any` with a named alias rather than a structural type invented from
 * usage — this package ships no TypeScript types for this shape, matching the same documented gap
 * at overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:136-151.
 */
import React from 'react'

// Chakra Components
import {Box, Fade, Flex, Stack, Text} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'

// Project Components
import {HideOnDesktop, HideOnMobile} from '../responsive'
import ItemVariantProvider from '../item-variant'
import CartItemVariantImage from '../item-variant/item-image'
import CartItemVariantName from '../item-variant/item-name'
import CartItemVariantAttributes from '../item-variant/item-attributes'
import CartItemVariantPrice from '../item-variant/item-price'
import LoadingSpinner from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/loading-spinner'
import BonusProductQuantity from './bonus-product-quantity'
import ProductQuantityPicker from './product-quantity-picker'

// Utilities
import {noop} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/utils'

// Hooks
import {useCurrency, useDerivedProduct} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks'

type SfccProduct = any

type ProductItemProps = {
    /** Product to be represented in the list item. */
    product: SfccProduct
    /** Child component representing the most prominent action to be performed by the user. */
    primaryAction?: React.ReactNode
    /** Child component representing the other actions relevant to the product to be performed by the user. */
    secondaryActions?: React.ReactNode
    /** Child component representing the delivery actions relevant to the product to be performed by the user. */
    deliveryActions?: React.ReactNode
    /** Callback function to be invoked whenever item quantity changes. */
    onItemQuantityChange?: (quantity: number) => any
    /**
     * Declared on the base file's propTypes but never read inside this component's own render
     * body — kept here only to mirror that declared surface one-for-one (zero functional diff,
     * SFCC-270). No return-type guarantee to derive from PropTypes.func, so typed loosely.
     */
    onAddItemToCart?: (...args: any[]) => any
    /** Renders a loading spinner with overlay if set to true. */
    showLoading?: boolean
    /** Declared on the base file's propTypes but never read inside this component's own render body — see onAddItemToCart above. */
    isWishlistItem?: boolean
    containerStyles?: Record<string, any>
    isRemoving?: boolean
    pickupInStore?: boolean
}

/**
 * Component representing a product item usually in a list with details about the product - name, variant, pricing, etc.
 * @returns A JSX element representing product item in a list (eg: wishlist, cart, etc).
 */
const ProductItem = ({
    product,
    primaryAction,
    secondaryActions,
    deliveryActions,
    onItemQuantityChange = noop,
    showLoading = false,
    containerStyles = {},
    isRemoving = false,
    pickupInStore = false
}: ProductItemProps) => {
    console.log('[overrides] product-item/index.tsx')
    const {stepQuantity, showInventoryMessage, inventoryMessage, quantity, setQuantity} =
        useDerivedProduct(product, false, false, pickupInStore)
    const {currency: activeCurrency} = useCurrency()
    return (
        <Box
            position="relative"
            data-testid={`sf-cart-item-${product.productId ? product.productId : product.id}`}
        >
            <ItemVariantProvider variant={product}>
                {showLoading && <LoadingSpinner />}
                <Stack layerStyle="cardBordered" align="flex-start" {...containerStyles}>
                    <Flex width="full" alignItems="flex-start" backgroundColor="white">
                        <CartItemVariantImage width={['88px', '136px']} mr={4} />
                        <Stack spacing={3} flex={1}>
                            <Flex align="flex-end" justify="space-between">
                                <Stack spacing={1}>
                                    <CartItemVariantName />
                                    <CartItemVariantAttributes excludeBonusLabel />
                                    <HideOnDesktop>
                                        <Box marginTop={2}>
                                            <CartItemVariantPrice
                                                align="left"
                                                currency={activeCurrency}
                                            />
                                        </Box>
                                    </HideOnDesktop>
                                </Stack>
                                {deliveryActions && !product.bonusProductLineItem && (
                                    <HideOnMobile>{deliveryActions}</HideOnMobile>
                                )}
                            </Flex>

                            {deliveryActions && !product.bonusProductLineItem && (
                                <HideOnDesktop>{deliveryActions}</HideOnDesktop>
                            )}

                            <Flex align="flex-end" justify="space-between">
                                <Stack spacing={1}>
                                    {!(isRemoving && product.bonusProductLineItem) &&
                                        (product.bonusProductLineItem ? (
                                            <BonusProductQuantity product={product} />
                                        ) : (
                                            <ProductQuantityPicker
                                                product={product}
                                                onItemQuantityChange={onItemQuantityChange}
                                                stepQuantity={stepQuantity}
                                                quantity={quantity}
                                                setQuantity={setQuantity}
                                            />
                                        ))}
                                </Stack>
                                <Stack>
                                    <HideOnMobile>
                                        <CartItemVariantPrice currency={activeCurrency} />
                                    </HideOnMobile>
                                    <Box display={['none', 'block', 'block', 'block']}>
                                        {primaryAction}
                                    </Box>
                                </Stack>
                            </Flex>

                            <Box>
                                {product && showInventoryMessage && (
                                    <Fade in={true}>
                                        <Text color="orange.600" fontWeight={600}>
                                            {inventoryMessage}
                                        </Text>
                                    </Fade>
                                )}
                            </Box>

                            {secondaryActions}
                        </Stack>
                    </Flex>

                    <Box display={['block', 'none', 'none', 'none']} w={'full'}>
                        {primaryAction}
                    </Box>
                </Stack>
            </ItemVariantProvider>
        </Box>
    )
}

export default ProductItem

                            <Flex align="flex-end" justify="space-between">
                                <Stack spacing={1}>
                                    <CartItemVariantName />
                                    <CartItemVariantAttributes excludeBonusLabel />
                                    <HideOnDesktop>
                                        <Box marginTop={2}>
                                            <CartItemVariantPrice
                                                align="left"
                                                currency={activeCurrency}
                                            />
                                        </Box>
                                    </HideOnDesktop>
                                </Stack>
                                {deliveryActions && !product.bonusProductLineItem && (
                                    <HideOnMobile>{deliveryActions}</HideOnMobile>
                                )}
                            </Flex>

                            {deliveryActions && !product.bonusProductLineItem && (
                                <HideOnDesktop>{deliveryActions}</HideOnDesktop>
                            )}

                            <Flex align="flex-end" justify="space-between">
                                <Stack spacing={1}>
                                    {!(isRemoving && product.bonusProductLineItem) &&
                                        (product.bonusProductLineItem ? (
                                            <BonusProductQuantity product={product} />
                                        ) : (
                                            <ProductQuantityPicker
                                                product={product}
                                                onItemQuantityChange={onItemQuantityChange}
                                                stepQuantity={stepQuantity}
                                                quantity={quantity}
                                                setQuantity={setQuantity}
                                            />
                                        ))}
                                </Stack>
                                <Stack>
                                    <HideOnMobile>
                                        <CartItemVariantPrice currency={activeCurrency} />
                                    </HideOnMobile>
                                    <Box display={['none', 'block', 'block', 'block']}>
                                        {primaryAction}
                                    </Box>
                                </Stack>
                            </Flex>

                            <Box>
                                {product && showInventoryMessage && (
                                    <Fade in={true}>
                                        <Text color="orange.600" fontWeight={600}>
                                            {inventoryMessage}
                                        </Text>
                                    </Fade>
                                )}
                            </Box>

                            {secondaryActions}
                        </Stack>
                    </Flex>

                    <Box display={['block', 'none', 'none', 'none']} w={'full'}>
                        {primaryAction}
                    </Box>
                </Stack>
            </ItemVariantProvider>
        </Box>
    )
}

export default ProductItem

 * `[overrides]` console.log marker.
 *
 * Deliberately NOT fixed here: `<Link {...props} color="black.600" to={...}>` spreads `props`
 * BEFORE the explicit `color`/`to`, the opposite order from item-image/item-attributes/item-price's
 * own `{...props}` placement (spread last) — so a caller-supplied `color` or `to` is silently
 * overridden here instead of taking precedence, unlike those three siblings. This is a verbatim,
 * byte-for-byte port of the base file per SFCC-270's zero-functional-diff scope (plan step 2.1);
 * addressing it, if warranted, belongs to a later step (2.2), not this one.
 *
 * `useItemVariant` is already imported via the relative `'.'` in the base file — unchanged here.
 * `Link` is not overridden anywhere in this repo (verified by directory listing at time of
 * writing), so it stays on the base `@salesforce/retail-react-app/...` path.
 */
import React from 'react'
import {useItemVariant} from '.'
import Link from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/link'
import {Heading} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'

/**
 * In the context of a cart product item variant, this components simply renders
 * the item's name using the cart item field `productName`. We use this field
 * rather than variant `name` field as the variant detail may not yet be
 * available upon rendering.
 */
const ItemName = (props: Record<string, any>) => {
    console.log('[overrides] item-name.tsx')
    const variant = useItemVariant()
    const productId = variant?.master?.masterId || variant.id

    return (
        <Heading as="h2" fontSize="md">
            <Link {...props} color="black.600" to={`/product/${productId}`}>
                {variant.productName || variant.name}
            </Link>
        </Heading>
    )
}

export default ItemName

/*
 * Copy-first port of node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-item/index.jsx
 * (retail-react-app 10.0.0), converted to TypeScript per AGENTS.md's copy-first rule (SFCC-270,
 * plan step 2.1). Zero functional diff at this step — TypeScript annotations, the import path
 * rewrites documented below, and the temporary `[overrides]` console.log marker are the only
 * changes; styling/behaviour changes are a later commit (2.2), not this one.
 *
 * Import path rewrites, per .claude/rules/overrideStyling.md's "Importing an already-overridden
 * component from a new component":
 * - `item-variant` / `item-variant/item-image` / `item-variant/item-name` /
 *   `item-variant/item-attributes` / `item-variant/item-price`: this repo overrides all five
 *   (SFCC-270, this same commit), so these are relative imports rather than the base
 *   `@salesforce/retail-react-app/...` path — a base-path import here would silently exercise the
 *   unstyled base components in Storybook/Vitest instead of these overrides.
 * - `./bonus-product-quantity` / `./product-quantity-picker`: same reasoning, both overridden in
 *   this same commit, in this same folder.
 * - `responsive` (`HideOnDesktop`/`HideOnMobile`): also already overridden in this repo
 *   (overrides/app/components/responsive/index.tsx) — and not just a styling port, a genuine
 *   behavioural difference (it moves the mobile/desktop split to Chakra's `md` breakpoint instead
 *   of the base's `lg`) — so this is rewritten to a relative import too, for the same reason.
 * - `shared/ui`, `loading-spinner`, `utils/utils`, and the `app/hooks` barrel (`useCurrency`/
 *   `useDerivedProduct`) are NOT overridden anywhere in this repo (verified by directory listing
 *   at time of writing) — these stay on the base `@salesforce/retail-react-app/...` path, since
 *   there is no local override to redirect to.
 *
 * `SfccProduct` is kept as `any` with a named alias rather than a structural type invented from
 * usage — this package ships no TypeScript types for this shape, matching the same documented gap
 * at overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:136-151.
 */
import React from 'react'

// Chakra Components
import {Box, Fade, Flex, Stack, Text} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'

// Project Components
import {HideOnDesktop, HideOnMobile} from '../responsive'
import ItemVariantProvider from '../item-variant'
import CartItemVariantImage from '../item-variant/item-image'
import CartItemVariantName from '../item-variant/item-name'
import CartItemVariantAttributes from '../item-variant/item-attributes'
import CartItemVariantPrice from '../item-variant/item-price'
import LoadingSpinner from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/loading-spinner'
import BonusProductQuantity from './bonus-product-quantity'
import ProductQuantityPicker from './product-quantity-picker'

// Utilities
import {noop} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/utils'

// Hooks
import {useCurrency, useDerivedProduct} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks'

type SfccProduct = any

type ProductItemProps = {
    /** Product to be represented in the list item. */
    product: SfccProduct
    /** Child component representing the most prominent action to be performed by the user. */
    primaryAction?: React.ReactNode
    /** Child component representing the other actions relevant to the product to be performed by the user. */
    secondaryActions?: React.ReactNode
    /** Child component representing the delivery actions relevant to the product to be performed by the user. */
    deliveryActions?: React.ReactNode
    /** Callback function to be invoked whenever item quantity changes. */
    onItemQuantityChange?: (quantity: number) => any
    /**
     * Declared on the base file's propTypes but never read inside this component's own render
     * body — kept here only to mirror that declared surface one-for-one (zero functional diff,
     * SFCC-270). No return-type guarantee to derive from PropTypes.func, so typed loosely.
     */
    onAddItemToCart?: (...args: any[]) => any
    /** Renders a loading spinner with overlay if set to true. */
    showLoading?: boolean
    /** Declared on the base file's propTypes but never read inside this component's own render body — see onAddItemToCart above. */
    isWishlistItem?: boolean
    containerStyles?: Record<string, any>
    isRemoving?: boolean
    pickupInStore?: boolean
}

/**
 * Component representing a product item usually in a list with details about the product - name, variant, pricing, etc.
 * @returns A JSX element representing product item in a list (eg: wishlist, cart, etc).
 */
const ProductItem = ({
    product,
    primaryAction,
    secondaryActions,
    deliveryActions,
    onItemQuantityChange = noop,
    showLoading = false,
    containerStyles = {},
    isRemoving = false,
    pickupInStore = false
}: ProductItemProps) => {
    console.log('[overrides] product-item/index.tsx')
    const {stepQuantity, showInventoryMessage, inventoryMessage, quantity, setQuantity} =
        useDerivedProduct(product, false, false, pickupInStore)
    const {currency: activeCurrency} = useCurrency()
    return (
        <Box
            position="relative"
            data-testid={`sf-cart-item-${product.productId ? product.productId : product.id}`}
        >
            <ItemVariantProvider variant={product}>
                {showLoading && <LoadingSpinner />}
                <Stack layerStyle="cardBordered" align="flex-start" {...containerStyles}>
                    <Flex width="full" alignItems="flex-start" backgroundColor="white">
                        <CartItemVariantImage width={['88px', '136px']} mr={4} />
                        <Stack spacing={3} flex={1}>
                            <Flex align="flex-end" justify="space-between">
                                <Stack spacing={1}>
                                    <CartItemVariantName />
                                    <CartItemVariantAttributes excludeBonusLabel />
                                    <HideOnDesktop>
                                        <Box marginTop={2}>
                                            <CartItemVariantPrice
                                                align="left"
                                                currency={activeCurrency}
                                            />
                                        </Box>
                                    </HideOnDesktop>
                                </Stack>
                                {deliveryActions && !product.bonusProductLineItem && (
                                    <HideOnMobile>{deliveryActions}</HideOnMobile>
                                )}
                            </Flex>

                            {deliveryActions && !product.bonusProductLineItem && (
                                <HideOnDesktop>{deliveryActions}</HideOnDesktop>
                            )}

                            <Flex align="flex-end" justify="space-between">
                                <Stack spacing={1}>
                                    {!(isRemoving && product.bonusProductLineItem) &&
                                        (product.bonusProductLineItem ? (
                                            <BonusProductQuantity product={product} />
                                        ) : (
                                            <ProductQuantityPicker
                                                product={product}
                                                onItemQuantityChange={onItemQuantityChange}
                                                stepQuantity={stepQuantity}
                                                quantity={quantity}
                                                setQuantity={setQuantity}
                                            />
                                        ))}
                                </Stack>
                                <Stack>
                                    <HideOnMobile>
                                        <CartItemVariantPrice currency={activeCurrency} />
                                    </HideOnMobile>
                                    <Box display={['none', 'block', 'block', 'block']}>
                                        {primaryAction}
                                    </Box>
                                </Stack>
                            </Flex>

                            <Box>
                                {product && showInventoryMessage && (
                                    <Fade in={true}>
                                        <Text color="orange.600" fontWeight={600}>
                                            {inventoryMessage}
                                        </Text>
                                    </Fade>
                                )}
                            </Box>

                            {secondaryActions}
                        </Stack>
                    </Flex>

                    <Box display={['block', 'none', 'none', 'none']} w={'full'}>
                        {primaryAction}
                    </Box>
                </Stack>
            </ItemVariantProvider>
        </Box>
    )
}

export default ProductItem

**product-item/index.tsx** — relative: `../responsive`, `../item-variant`, `../item-variant/item-image`, `../item-variant/item-name`, `../item-variant/item-attributes`, `../item-variant/item-price`, `./bonus-product-quantity`, `./product-quantity-picker`. Base path (unchanged): `shared/ui`, `loading-spinner`, `utils/utils`, `app/hooks` (barrel, for `useCurrency`/`useDerivedProduct`).

**product-item/bonus-product-quantity.tsx** — base path only: `react-intl`, `shared/ui`. No item-variant/product-item cross-imports.

**product-item/product-quantity-picker.tsx** — base path only: `react-intl`, `shared/ui`, `quantity-picker` (not overridden anywhere in this repo).

**item-variant/index.tsx** — no SFCC imports at all (just `react`).

**item-variant/item-image.tsx** — relative: `.` (for `useItemVariant`, unchanged from base, which already used `.`). Base path: `shared/ui`, `react-intl`, `utils/image-groups-utils`.

**item-variant/item-name.tsx** — relative: `.`. Base path: `link` (not overridden anywhere in this repo), `shared/ui`.

**item-variant/item-attributes.tsx** — relative: `.` **(rewritten from the base's absolute package path — see below)**. Base path: `shared/ui`, `promo-popover`, `app/hooks` barrel, `app/hooks/use-current-basket`, `utils/product-utils`, plus the real npm package `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`.

**item-variant/item-price.tsx** — relative: `.` (unchanged from base). Base path: `shared/ui`, `utils/product-utils`, `display-price`.

## Two judgment calls worth flagging explicitly

1. **The task brief's own example list was wrong about `responsive`.** It named `responsive` as an example of a module *not* overridden in this repo (so imports of it should stay on the base path). I checked directly: `overrides/app/components/responsive/index.tsx` **does** exist, and it's a real behavioural override (moves the mobile/desktop split to Chakra's `md` breakpoint instead of the base's `lg` — not a cosmetic port). So per `overrideStyling.md`'s actual rule (which the brief itself told me to apply by checking real repo state), I rewrote `product-item/index.tsx`'s `HideOnDesktop`/`HideOnMobile` import to the relative `../responsive`, not the base path the brief's illustrative list implied. I'm flagging this because it's the brief's assumption failing to hold, not my own invented interpretation — the rule I followed is the one written down; only the example was stale.

2. **`item-attributes.jsx` (base) imports `useItemVariant` inconsistently with its own three siblings** — item-image/item-name/item-price all already use the relative `.`, but item-attributes uses the absolute `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/item-variant` path. Since `item-variant/index.tsx` is itself being overridden in this exact commit, I rewrote this one to `.` too, matching its siblings — same rule as #1, just discovered within the base source rather than the task brief.

Both are documented in-file with the reasoning, not just decided silently.

## Two TS-only fixes needed to get a clean compile (both documented in-place, both zero runtime/behavior diff)
- `item-price.tsx`: `PricePerItemProps.basePrice` tightened from optional (matching base `PropTypes.number`, no `.isRequired`) to required `number` — `<FormattedNumber value={basePrice}>` needs `number | bigint`, and both real call sites in the file only ever render `<PricePerItem>` from behind a `priceData?.pricePerUnit &&` guard, so it's never actually undefined at runtime either way.
- `item-attributes.tsx`: added one `?.` (`productBundleData?.bundledProducts?.map(...)`) — the SDK's real `Product` type makes `bundledProducts` optional even once `productBundleData` itself is truthy; base JS didn't need the guard, strict null checks do.

Both use the same "Deviation from the base file" comment label already established in `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:659-661` and `:1019-1022` — cited directly, not invented.

## One thing I caught and fixed on myself mid-task
My first draft of `product-item/index.tsx` trimmed the original `@param {type}` JSDoc lines on `ProductItem` down to a shorter form (matching a style precedent elsewhere in the repo). On review that was an unrequested edit — AGENTS.md says don't remove existing comments, and this was meant to be a verbatim port. Restored the original six-line JSDoc block exactly, re-ran `tsc --noEmit` and the full suite after — both still clean. Flagging it so it's not silently invisible in this report.

## Unverified / lower-confidence spots (mine, not yours)
- `usePromotions`/`useProducts`/`useProduct` come from `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`, which does ship real `.d.ts` (unlike the plain-JS retail-react-app files). I didn't manually audit their generic signatures against my loosely-typed (`any`-parameter) callback usage — I wrote the port matching the base JS logic and let `tsc` be the actual arbiter. It came back clean, but I'm noting I leaned on the compiler rather than a manual signature read-through for these three.
- `useDerivedProduct`'s exact parameter/return shape is inferred as `any` (no `.d.ts` in the base package), so nothing about its 4-arg call in `product-item/index.tsx` was independently type-checked beyond "does it compile" — same as the base JS's own lack of guarantees here, just noting where the safety net is thin.

## What Marcel is missing
`overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` (already-merged, existing code — not touched by me) has the exact same bug class as #1 above, undiscovered until now: its line 82 imports `HideOnDesktop`/`HideOnMobile` from the base `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/responsive` path, even though `responsive` is overridden in this repo with a real breakpoint behavior change. That means product-view's Storybook stories and Vitest tests have been silently exercising the base `lg`-breakpoint split instead of Zimmermann's `md` split this whole time — the real app renders correctly (webpack's resolver redirects it), but anything checked in Storybook/Vitest for that file has had the wrong breakpoint under it. `overrideStyling.md` already tracks one instance of this exact bug class (product-tile's `DisplayPrice` import) as "known, not yet fixed" — this is a second, previously-undocumented instance, outside this step's scope to fix. Separately, smaller: `item-variant/` has no CODEOWNERS entry at all (unlike `product-item/`, which is properly Tier-2-gated to Squad B) — so once this step's files get a PR, `item-variant/`'s files won't auto-request any reviewer.
